senses.gloss:
क्रूरा

KRŪRĀ (krodhā) . A daughter of prajāpati dakṣa. She became the wife of kaśyapa. A large number of Asuras were born to her. They all were very cruel and were called Krodhavaśas. (mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 65, Stanza 32).

क्रूर

KRŪRA . A country in Ancient india. (mahābhārata, bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9, Stanza 65).
